## Ibn Khaldun on time

Ibn Khaldun (1332–1406) approaches time within Islamic Philosophy. Royal authority rests on ʿaṣabiyya (group feeling); conquest succeeds when solidarity is strong, then softens under sedentary luxury. The past resembles the future enough for patterned explanation. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets time most directly—useful for searches such as “ibn khaldun quotes on time.”

## How to use this page
